project.title: The Message
project.source_text:
Andre Athar sits at a small wooden desk in a quiet apartment and lowers his eyes toward a folded note.

At the glass doorway, Andre looks back toward the room. His off-screen voice says: Not again.

shots.action: Andre sits at a small wooden desk along the left wall. A folded white paper note rests on the desk. His face stays visible in a gentle three-quarter view. He lowers his eyes toward the note once, keeping his body still.

shots.action: Andre already stands inside the closed glass doorway, torso angled toward it. He slowly turns his head toward the room once, showing a gentle three-quarter face with quiet resignation. His body remains still.
